title: Storage Cases
descriptionHtml:
Keep your bricks in order with hardware storage cases. Featuring a convenient hook for storage and a snap-on lid, these cases will help you keep your bricks in place and easy to find.

Measuring 7.125 x 4.875 x 8.75 inches each.

The cases come with a hook for storage and a snap-on lid.
Their translucent design makes it easy to identify the bricks inside.
Additionally, the cases are environmentally friendly, as they are made of recyclable plastic.
